findings.title: Maintenance/REPAIR status never grounds equipment; assign_equipment ignores unsafe status
findings.attack_chain:
1. Crane is overdue / needs critical brake repair.
2. Caller invokes schedule_maintenance(...); MaintenanceRecord is stored but equipment.status stays AVAILABLE (MAINTENANCE/REPAIR never set by any API).
3. get_available_equipment() still returns the crane; dispatch uses it.
4. Even if status is forced to REPAIR, assign_equipment() has no status check — sets IN_USE and sends unsafe crane to site.
5. return_equipment(hours_used=-N) rewinds the hour meter, further hiding overdue service.
Impact: Tower crane / heavy equipment with open repair is authorized for site use — struck-by / collapse life-safety.
findings.existing_controls: EquipmentStatus enum includes MAINTENANCE/REPAIR/RETIRED; get_available_equipment filters AVAILABLE only — but nothing transitions into MAINTENANCE/REPAIR, and assign_equipment never consults status.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not site-logistics crane capacity soft-check; not equipment-telematics FAULT-unused soft alerts. This is the fleet assignment authority itself with a dead maintenance gate.
findings.poc: schedule_maintenance → still available; status=REPAIR → assign succeeds → IN_USE; return(-200) rewinds hours 600→400.
findings.remediation: schedule_maintenance must set MAINTENANCE/REPAIR and clear only after completed_date + competent sign-off. assign_equipment must reject non-AVAILABLE. Reject hours_used < 0. Block assign when current_hours >= next_maintenance_hours.

findings.title: Caller-chosen incident_type underclassifies LOST_TIME/FATALITY as NEAR_MISS (TRIR=0) + self-complete CA
findings.attack_chain:
1. Lost-time injury occurs (injured person present).
2. Attacker/complicit reporter calls report_incident(incident_type=NEAR_MISS, ...) with the same injury facts.
3. osha_recordable stays False because only MEDICAL_TREATMENT/LOST_TIME/FATALITY auto-flag.
4. calculate_trir / metrics / OSHA report show 0 recordables (honest LOST_TIME → TRIR 1.0).
5. Same actor assign_corrective_action + complete_corrective_action(verification_notes=attacker) marks CA completed with no independent verifier and no CLOSED gate.
Impact: OSHA log / TRIR / DART fraud; insurance and prequalification deception; hazards closed on paper.
findings.existing_controls: Auto-sets osha_recordable for three severe types — but type is fully caller-controlled with no cross-check against injured_person / days_lost / description. No role separation on CA completion.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not safety-inspection Pass forge (checklist pass/fail). This is OSHA severity classification + TRIR metric authority and CA self-verify on the incident system.
findings.poc: Same injury: LOST_TIME → TRIR=1.0/osha=True; NEAR_MISS → TRIR=0.0/osha=False; CA completed by same actor.
findings.remediation: Derive recordability from injury outcome fields; forbid NEAR_MISS when injured_person or days_lost>0; require independent verifier ≠ assigned_to/reported_by for complete_corrective_action; only CLOSE when all CAs verified.

findings.title: add_location overwrites canonical location codes with unbounded/zero factors → collapses adjusted bids
findings.attack_chain:
1. Estimate pipeline calls CWICRLocationFactor.adjust_cost(..., 'US-NYC') for regional pricing.
2. Attacker calls add_location(LocationFactor(location_code='US-NYC', labor_factor=0.01, material_factor=0.01, equipment_factor=0.01, ...)) — no authZ, no bounds, overwrites built-in table.
3. Subsequent adjust_cost/adjust_estimate apply ~0.01 relative factors.
4. PoC: $1,000,000 base → honest NYC ~$1,292,500; poisoned → $10,000.
Impact: Underbid / underfunded labor-material budgets; poisoned multi-location comparisons and payment baselines.
findings.existing_controls: Built-in LOCATION_FACTORS table exists, but add_location blindly replaces by location_code with no range checks or admin role.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not cwicr-rate-updater (unit rate cells in CWICR DB). Distinct geographic factor layer that can overwrite published city codes used by adjust_cost/adjust_estimate.
findings.poc: Overwrite US-NYC factors to 0.01 → adjusted cost 1292500 → 10000.
findings.remediation: Disallow overwrite of built-in codes without elevated role; clamp factors to sane band (e.g. 0.5–2.5); audit trail; reject non-positive factors.

findings.title: Unbounded min_factor/max_factor in item risk collapses or negates Monte Carlo contingency
findings.attack_chain:
1. Risk-adjusted estimate calls analyze_risk(items) / calculate_item_risk.
2. Attacker supplies items with min_factor=1.0, max_factor=1.0 (or negative range).
3. define_item_risk accepts factors with no bounds; run_monte_carlo / deterministic p80 uses them.
4. contingency = p80 - base_estimate → ~0 (UNIFORM equal) or large negative (negative factors).
5. Bid / contingency allowance underfunded while reports still claim 'risk-adjusted'.
Impact: Contingency wipe or credit against base — false competitiveness and unfunded risk.
findings.existing_controls: DEFAULT_RISK_PARAMS provide defaults only when min/max omitted; caller overrides are trusted. No clamp that max>min>0.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not budget-variance use_contingency (spending pot). Not cwicr-rate-updater unit rates. This poisons the contingency recommendation engine via distribution factors.
findings.poc: Honest triangular 0.9–1.4 → contingency ~$201k; UNIFORM 1.0–1.0 → $0; UNIFORM -2.0–-0.5 → contingency ~-$1.79M.
findings.remediation: Clamp min_factor/max_factor (e.g. 0.5≤min<max≤3.0); reject non-positive costs; require risk_level consistency with factor span; floor contingency at 0.
